gloss: work done standing; job on one's feet

definitions.gloss: work done standing; job on one's feet
definitions.explanation: Work that keeps a person standing for most of the day, such as shop, factory or kitchen work. Often mentioned as a cause of tired legs and back pain.

examples.japanese: {立|た}ち{仕事|しごと}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{疲|つか}れる→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧。
examples.english: Working on your feet is tiring.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一日中|いちにちじゅう}→一日中：09519_ichinichijuu⟧{立|た}ち{仕事|しごと}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦むくんだ→むくむ：07354_mukumu⟧。
examples.english: After standing at work all day, my feet are swollen.

examples.japanese: ⟦レジ→レジ：00879_reji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{立|た}ち{仕事|しごと}な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{歩|ある}き→歩く：00538_aruku⟧やすい⟦{靴|くつ}→靴：00725_kutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: Cashier work is done on your feet, so it's important to choose comfortable shoes.

notes:
The opposite is {座|すわ}り{仕事|しごと} (work done sitting), also called ⟦デスクワーク→デスクワーク：31329_desukuwaaku⟧.
